# Shack's Plumbing

> Shack's Plumbing is a licensed plumbing company in Dallas and North Texas owned by master plumber Ray Mays, with over 40 years of experience, voted a Nextdoor Neighborhood Favorite 2021–2025.

## Key facts
- Business: Shack's Plumbing
- Owner: Ray Mays
- Location: Serving Dallas, North Dallas, Plano & Allen, TX
- Specialties: cast iron & sewer drains, water service lines, leak repair, gas piping & ranges, water heaters, clogs & pool lines
- Recognition: Nextdoor Neighborhood Favorite 2021–2025
- Licensing: licensed and insured; pulls city permits
- Phone: (214) 900-5430
- Address: Serving Dallas, North Dallas, Plano & Allen, TX
- Hours: Every day 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM
- Services: Cast Iron & Sewer Drains, Water Service Lines, Leak Repair, Gas Piping & Ranges, Water Heaters, Clogs & Pool Lines
